acceptanceCriteria.text: The Runtime Appliance job on trusted `main` passes the MTNAI_BOOT staging step.
The direct Runtime Appliance Golden Path step executes rather than being skipped because of staging failure.
Production Lima composition executes rather than being skipped because of staging failure.
Runtime Appliance certification evidence is produced on successful trusted-main execution.
Certified Runtime Appliance artifact upload executes from the certified bytes.
Failure modes remain fail-closed and emit bounded diagnostics.
